source_publication_window.note: The snapshot is a single point-in-time aggregate, not a throughput interval.

component_versions.adapter_and_bridge: See prior FEED-03/backlog report; not re-hashed in this snapshot.

incoming.decision_unit: unique incoming source messages in the source-date window

owned.decision_unit: unique owned source messages in the source-date window

api_active_items.visibility_note: API aggregate is not proof each item was rendered in a client session.

expired_pending.unit: older pending outbox segments outside the current 10-day source window
expired_pending.note: This earlier global reading must not be added to the 8972 in-window pending count.

limitations: Collector fetched-before-persistence and pre-filter discard counters are unavailable historically.
Messages, extracted segments, API items and HTTP attempts are different units and are not added together.
API active counts can include items not represented by this exact collector window.
No client-side visibility or two consecutive hourly rate measurements are included.
No per-source labels, text, phone numbers, or raw payloads are included.
